harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured NFS share of /srv/nfs/shared on node1, exported to node2, and mounted at /mnt/shared on node2. Created shared dataops user/group (UID/GID 4500) on both nodes, set ownership dataops:dataops and mode 2770 on both the export and mount point. Opened firewalld for NFS/rpc-bind/mountd on node1. Verified bidirectional read/write consistency (files created on either node show correct dataops:dataops ownership on both sides, root is squashed as expected). Made the mount persistent via /etc/fstab with _netdev. Completed mandatory restart protocol: captured healthy baselines (boot_id, service/mount state, ownership) on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polled until each came back, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and verified NFS server/export and client mount/data fully recovered after each restart, including a final round-trip write test.
actions_performed: Inspected OS and baseline state on node1 and node2 (AlmaLinux 9.6, no dataops user, no nfs-utils)
Created dataops group/user with UID/GID 4500 on node1 and node2
Installed nfs-utils on node1 and node2
Created /srv/nfs/shared on node1 with owner dataops:dataops mode 2770
Created /etc/exports.d/shared.exports exporting /srv/nfs/shared to node2 IP with rw,sync,no_subtree_check,root_squash; enabled and started nfs-server; ran exportfs -ra
Created /mnt/shared on node2 with owner dataops:dataops mode 2770
Opened firewalld ports for nfs, rpc-bind, mountd services on node1 after initial mount hang
Mounted the NFS share on node2 at /mnt/shared and verified type nfs4, correct ownership/mode
Added persistent fstab entry on node2 with _netdev option
Verified bidirectional file creation preserves dataops:dataops ownership across both nodes; confirmed root is squashed
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service state, exports, mount state) on both nodes

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified nfs-server active, export intact, directory perms intact, and node2's mount self-healed with a successful write
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, verified mount auto-recovered via fstab, data persisted, and new write succeeded
Cleaned up all test files created during verification

evidence.requirement: dataops user/group with UID/GID 4500 created on node1 and node2
evidence.summary: id dataops shows uid=4500(dataops) gid=4500(dataops) on both nodes

evidence.requirement: /srv/nfs/shared created on node1 with dataops:dataops mode 2770
evidence.summary: ls -ld shows drwxrws---. 2 dataops dataops /srv/nfs/shared

evidence.requirement: NFS export configured and active on node1
evidence.summary: exportfs -v shows /srv/nfs/shared exported to node2 IP; firewall opened for nfs/rpc-bind/mountd and nfs-server active

evidence.requirement: NFS share mounted at /mnt/shared on node2 with correct ownership/mode
evidence.summary: mount output shows nfs4 mount from node1; ls -ld shows drwxrws---. 2 dataops dataops

evidence.requirement: Mount persisted in fstab for node2
evidence.summary: fstab entry with _netdev added for /mnt/shared

evidence.requirement: Cross-node write consistency: files created on either node retain dataops:dataops ownership on both sides
evidence.summary: File created on node2 (from_node2.txt) and node1 (from_node1.txt) both show as dataops:dataops on both nodes via NFS; root access correctly squashed

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id 8c28f3cd..., nfs-server active, export present, directory perms intact

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot issued (stream closed), node unreachable during reboot, then boot_id changed to 4ab532c4... confirming restart

evidence.requirement: node1 recovered state post-restart (NFS service, export, data)
evidence.summary: nfs-server active, export intact, directory ownership/perms preserved after reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 mount self-healed after node1 restart
evidence.summary: New file successfully written to /mnt/shared after node1 came back, hard mount recovered automatically

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: boot_id e65e6bcf..., mount active and functional

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: reboot issued (stream closed), node unreachable during reboot, then boot_id changed to bfd32cf6... confirming restart

evidence.requirement: node2 recovered state post-restart (mount and data)
evidence.summary: Mount auto-restored via fstab _netdev entry, prior data present with correct ownership, and new write from node2 visible on node1 with correct dataops:dataops ownership
